card.name: Word after verb or noun in general prose
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'life' after 'of', 'on' or 'invaluable', and particles like 'off' or 'through' after verbs such as 'showed' and 'talk'. It appears in general web prose, not drug text.

modes.label: The word life
modes.description: 'life' in phrases like 'facts of life', 'thoughts on life', 'life skills'.
modes.example: Every once in a while it is worth pausing to reconsider certain facts of<< life>> that we have almost always taken as given

modes.label: Particle after a verb
modes.description: 'off' or 'through' right after a verb of showing or talking.
modes.example: It's best to help them talk<< through>> the situation and support them if they decide

card.writes: Suppresses 'spin' forms, which hints the unit steers away from spin-related words after these phrases.
card.plain: It fires on 'life' and on little words like 'off' or 'through' after verbs in everyday prose.
